userStories.title: Database and migrations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a SQLite database with numbered migrations so data persists.
acceptanceCriteria: src/db/index.ts exports getDb() using node:sqlite DatabaseSync at DATABASE_PATH env or data/app.db; tests can pass ':memory:'
src/db/migrate.ts applies src/db/migrations/NNN_*.sql in order and records them in _migrations (idempotent)
001_core.sql creates orgs(id, name, join_code unique, finance_email, created_at), users(id, org_id, email unique, name, password_hash, role, created_at), sessions(id, user_id, expires_at)
Migrations run automatically on first getDb()
Vitest test proves migrations run twice without error and tables exist
npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test all pass
